column.name: id
column.remarks: The baseline data report free allocation identifier

changeSet.author: dridakisc@unisystems.gr
changeSet.rollback: delete from baseline_data_report_free_allocation where account_id in (select account_id from request where type='BDR' and status='COMPLETED');

changeSet.author: dridakisc@unisystems.gr
changeSet.sql: with in_progress_bdr_requests as (select account_id, id from request where type='BDR' and status='IN_PROGRESS'), filtered_request_actions as (select bdr_reqs.account_id, ra.id, ra.creation_date, ra.type, COALESCE((ra.payload->'bdr'->>'isApplicationForFreeAllocation')::boolean, false) as is_fa from request_action ra join in_progress_bdr_requests bdr_reqs on ra.request_id = bdr_reqs.id where ra.type in ('BDR_APPLICATION_SENT_TO_REGULATOR', 'BDR_APPLICATION_COMPLETED', 'BDR_APPLICATION_RE_INITIATED')), max_request_actions_per_acc_id as (select account_id, max(creation_date) as max_creation_date from filtered_request_actions group by account_id), max_request_actions_info_per_acc_id as (select fra.* from filtered_request_actions fra join max_request_actions_per_acc_id mfrapa on fra.account_id = mfrapa.account_id and fra.creation_date = mfrapa.max_creation_date) insert into baseline_data_report_free_allocation (id, account_id, free_allocation) select nextval('baseline_data_report_free_allocation_seq'), account_id, is_fa from max_request_actions_info_per_acc_id;
changeSet.rollback: delete from baseline_data_report_free_allocation where account_id in (select account_id from request where type='BDR' and status='IN_PROGRESS');
